task.title: Changing Default Credentials
task.shortdesc: Change the default credentials for the to prevent unauthorized access to the network configuration.

prereq.p: Before you change the default credentials, make sure that:

ul.li: A computer or mobile device is connected to the .
You have the current credentials for the .
You have permission to change the router configuration.

prereq.note: conref Use a wired connection when possible. A wired connection remains active if the wireless settings change.

context.p: The credentials for the permit an authorized user to change settings in the . Default credentials can be known to other users. Change them during the initial setup.
context.note: The administrator password is different from the . The administrator password protects the router settings. The Wi-Fi password controls access to the wireless network.
Limit administrator access to trusted devices and authorized users. Disable remote management if remote access is not required.

step.cmd: Open a supported web browser on the connected device.

step.stepresult: The sign-in page for the opens.

step.cmd: Sign in to the with the current administrator credentials.

info.p: The account settings can appear under Administration, System, or Account Management.
info.note: The menu names can differ by software version.

step.cmd: Select the option to change the administrator password.

info.p: Create a long and unique password. Use the password requirements shown in the .
info.note: Do not use the as the administrator password.
Do not continue to use the default administrator password.

step.cmd: Enter the new administrator password again.

info.p: Make sure that both entries are identical.
The can end the current session after the password changes.

step.stepresult: The new administrator password is saved.

step.cmd: Sign in again with the new administrator password.
step.stepresult: The opens with the new administrator credentials.

info.p: Disable remote management if administrators do not require access from outside the local network.
If remote management is required, restrict access to trusted sources and use a secure connection.

result.p: The default administrator password is replaced. The new credentials now protect access to the .

postreq.p: Store the new administrator password in a secure location. Use a trusted password manager when one is available.
Do not store the password in an unprotected document, email message, or shared file.
If the new credentials do not work, follow the account recovery instructions in the or contact the .
